intent_summary: Caller-supplied reset points divide a single-resolution series into independently trained and calibrated regimes.

criteria.criterion: Integer positions and exact observed dates or timestamps can identify reset boundaries.
criteria.notes: Positions and observed dates are exercised end to end; timestamp normalization and exact matching are implemented directly.

criteria.criterion: Each new regime rebuilds its reference, trend, and calibration without crossing earlier boundaries.
criteria.notes: Each segment initializes separate state and passes its own start to forecasts. Tests verify three calibrated regimes and no cross-boundary evidence or findings.

criteria.criterion: Repeated, out-of-range, or unmatched reset points are rejected.
criteria.notes: Validation rejects literal duplicates and different declarations resolving to the same position, invalid positions, and unmatched dates/timestamps.

criteria.criterion: CLI reset options produce the same resolved positions and suppress departures explained by the declared boundaries.
criteria.notes: CLI assertions establish positions [50, 100] and removal of the unmarked-regime episodes.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
